held_by_instantly.label: Email by Instantly
held_by_instantly.hint: Instantly sends this person's email in this client, so Zenbree sends them no email.

stop_pending.label: Stopping in Instantly
stop_pending.hint: They replied, opted out or their address bounced. Zenbree sends nothing to them until Instantly confirms the stop.

stop_failed.label: Stop failed in Instantly
stop_failed.hint: Instantly did not confirm the stop, so Zenbree sends nothing to them. Retry it, or confirm it by hand, on the Instantly card in Integrations.

stopped.label: Stopped in Instantly
stopped.hint: The stop is done: Instantly confirmed it, a member confirmed it by hand, or Instantly no longer had them. Zenbree does not write to them again.

detail.missingValue: No value for {tokens}. Keeps the campaign open until they have a value and you regenerate the values.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the values?
regenerate.description: Each person's values are read again from the list. People who waited for a value start once they have one.
regenerate.rewritten: Messages waiting for approval, and approved messages that have not gone out yet, are written again from the new values. Your edits and approvals of them are lost.
regenerate.unchanged: Messages already sent or in sending do not change.

reasons.paused: The conversation is on {sender}, which is paused. Resume it to continue.
